records.question: Which funding agencies accounted for more than 10 percent of all FY2024 obligations?
records.gold_sql: WITH agency_totals AS (SELECT funding_agency_name, SUM(federal_action_obligation) AS total_obligation FROM award_transactions WHERE fiscal_year = 2024 GROUP BY funding_agency_name), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(total_obligation) AS overall_total FROM agency_totals) SELECT a.funding_agency_name, a.total_obligation FROM agency_totals a CROSS JOIN grand_total g WHERE a.total_obligation > g.overall_total * 0.10 ORDER BY a.total_obligation DESC
records.predicted_sql:
WITH agency_obligations AS (
  SELECT
    funding_agency_name,
    SUM(federal_action_obligation) AS total_obligations
  FROM award_transactions
  WHERE fiscal_year = 2024
  GROUP BY funding_agency_name
),
overall_obligations AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(federal_action_obligation) AS overall_total
  FROM award_transactions
  WHERE fiscal_year = 2024
)
SELECT
  a.funding_agency_name,
  a.total_obligations,
  (a.total_obligations / o.overall_total) * 100 AS obligation_percentage
FROM agency_obligations a
CROSS JOIN overall_obligations o
WHERE (a.total_obligations / o.overall_total) > 0.10
ORDER BY obligation_percentage DESC
